items.title: 1 Cash-Producing Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: A company that generates cash isn’t automatically a winner. Some businesses stockpile cash but fail to reinvest wisely, limiting their ability to expand.

items.title: Is MSCI Stock Underperforming the Nasdaq?
items.summary: Though MSCI has lagged behind the broader Nasdaq Composite over the past year, Wall Street analysts remain strongly optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Garden Apartment Pricing Reflects Rising Supply Risk
items.summary: Garden apartment pricing is reflecting higher supply risk as cap-rate pressure grows and July transaction volume remains soft.

items.title: Rising Bond Yields Threaten Commercial Real Estate Recovery
items.summary: Rising bond yields threaten the CRE recovery by pressuring property values, liquidity, and institutional investment worldwide.

items.title: Saylor Urges MSCI to Drop 'Discriminatory' Rule That Would Delete Strategy
items.summary: The proposed screen would cut three companies from MSCI's global indexes in November, with Strategy the largest by some distance.

items.title: Michael Saylor’s Strategy Calls MSCI’s New Delisting Test ‘Fundamentally Flawed,’ Says It’s Damaging ‘Its Reputation’
items.summary: Strategy asked MSCI to withdraw the proposal or apply changes only prospectively going forward.

items.title: Turkey tightens hedge fund rules amid concerns over market manipulation
items.summary: Investing.com -- Turkey’s markets regulator tightened rules governing hedge funds on Saturday, introducing limits on concentrated investments and related-party exposure amid concerns over unusual market returns, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: Hotel Sales Jump 28% as Buyers Take On Renovations
items.summary: Hotel sales climbed 28% year over year in the first half as buyers took on capital-heavy properties and luxury demand stayed strong.
